question:
Choose the word that is opposite in meaning to the given word.

Similar
solution:
The correct answer is "**Unlike**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
 
 
• **"Similar" means ****having a resemblance or likeness.**(समान)

 
 
• ​Example: Both the dresses look so similar.
 
 
 
• **Unlike means not similar or in contrast to or different from.**(भिन्न)
 
 
• Example: Unlike her brother, she is a well mannered kid.
 
 
 
 
 
• Thus, it is clear that the word "unlike" is the opposite of "similar."

Hence, **the correct answer is option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1 - Bizarre means very strange or unusual. It is not the opposite of similar. (विचित्र)
 
• Option 2 - Resemblant is not a commonly used word. It means resembling or similar in appearance.(सदृश)
 
• Option 4 - Secretive means not willing to share information or be open. It is not the opposite of similar.(गुप्त)
